recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞核偏位、細胞質豐富且深藍，部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），核染色質較粗、偶見核仁與雙核細胞，屬漿母細胞（plasmablast）形態，符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical cells, roughly two to three times the size of the adjacent neutrophil, clustered together
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with moderate N:C ratio; occasional binucleate cell
Coarsely granular to vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with a paranuclear pale hof in several cells
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; background red cells, a neutrophil and a granulated cell
describe_en: Smear shows an aggregate of large atypical plasmacytoid cells in a background of red cells and scattered granulocytes. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse to vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several with a paranuclear hof; a binucleate form is present. The cells are considerably larger and more immature than mature plasma cells. Findings are consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma in the appropriate context; correlation with CD138/MUM1 positivity, loss of CD20/PAX5, EBER ISH and MYC status is recommended.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; myeloma is favored by a serum/urine M-protein, lytic bone lesions and a prior myeloma history, while plasmablastic lymphoma is more often EBER-positive and extramedullary in immunodeficient patients.
PEL shows similar immunoblastic-plasmablastic cells but arises in body cavity effusions and is HHV8 (LANA-1) positive.
It shares the plasmablastic phenotype but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining, usually from CLTC::ALK.
Immunoblasts have a single central prominent nucleolus and retain CD20 and PAX5, which plasmablastic lymphoma lacks.
